verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Quo publishes its own MCP server and connectors so outside agents can act on Quo data. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing shows Quo, or its Sona AI agent, can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. Since Quo ships an AI agent, an MCP-client capability is conceivable, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
